vulpix-inferno.name: Inferno
vulpix-inferno.description: Bond skill: engulfs a foe up to 3 hexes away in flame (Power 100), Burning it for 2 turns.

vulpix-feint-attack.name: Feint Attack
vulpix-feint-attack.description: Bond skill: a sly feint (Power 55) that leaves the foe Exposed for 1 turn.

vulpix-flash-fire.name: Flash Fire
vulpix-flash-fire.description: Immune to Burn; its Fire-type moves deal 10% more damage.

vulpix-lustrous-coat.name: Lustrous Coat
vulpix-lustrous-coat.description: Its gleaming coat wards off blows: takes 10% less damage.

vulpix-incinerate.name: Incinerate
vulpix-incinerate.description: New skill: scorches a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 50).

vulpix-drought.name: Drought
vulpix-drought.description: Its harsh sunlight scorches: deals 20% more damage to Burned foes.

vulpix-distant-flames.name: Distant Flames
vulpix-distant-flames.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes 2+ hexes away.

vulpix-will-o-wisp.name: Will-O-Wisp
vulpix-will-o-wisp.description: New skill: an eerie flame Burns a foe up to 2 hexes away for 3 turns.

vulpix-lingering-grudge.name: Lingering Grudge
vulpix-lingering-grudge.description: Its curses run deep: statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

vulpix-mystic-tails.name: Mystic Tails
vulpix-mystic-tails.description: Heals 4% of its max HP at the start of each turn.

vulpix-heat-wave.name: Heat Wave
vulpix-heat-wave.description: New skill: a scorching gust hits a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 80).

vulpix-ward-of-nine-tails.name: Ward of Nine Tails
vulpix-ward-of-nine-tails.description: Immune to Sleep, Paralysis and Freeze.

vulpix-nimble-fox.name: Nimble Fox
vulpix-nimble-fox.description: Slips away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

vulpix-overheat.name: Overheat
vulpix-overheat.description: New skill: an all-out blast of fire at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 100).

vulpix-hexing-flames.name: Hexing Flames
vulpix-hexing-flames.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes with any status.

vulpix-mystic-fox.name: Mystic Fox
vulpix-mystic-fox.description: Gives the team 1 Bond whenever it lands a combo.

vulpix-nine-tailed-curse.name: Nine-Tailed Curse
vulpix-nine-tailed-curse.description: Capstone. Its ranged moves fire over Pokémon; its statuses spread to adjacent foes on a knockout.

vulpix-ageless-fox.name: Ageless Fox
vulpix-ageless-fox.description: Capstone. Takes 15% less damage and sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

vulpix-safeguard.name: Safeguard
vulpix-safeguard.description: Bond skill: a mystic veil clears foes' statuses on it and adjacent allies; Fortified 1 turn.

vulpix-roar.name: Roar
vulpix-roar.description: New skill: a fierce roar drives a foe up to 2 hexes away 2 hexes back.

vulpix-swift.name: Swift
vulpix-swift.description: New skill: star-shaped rays at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 70).

vulpix-mystical-fire.name: Mystical Fire
vulpix-mystical-fire.description: New skill: a mystical flame at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 80).

vulpix-confuse-ray.name: Confuse Ray
vulpix-confuse-ray.description: New skill: an eerie light at a foe up to 2 hexes away: Confused for 2 turns.
